tiers.t1: native edit (crop's own gene, NGT cat-1 candidate)

_schema.note: Gene/function/evidence are sourced facts. Portability tier, linkage, pleiotropy and IP are indicative research signals, not lab results or legal advice.

entries.name: Shoot sodium exclusion
entries.source: Wild wheat (Triticum monococcum, Nax2); rice OsHKT1;5 / SKC1
entries.does: Retrieves Na+ from the xylem so less reaches the shoot; keeps leaf Na+/K+ low under salinity.
entries.linkage: Native edit: no drag. Via wild-wheat introgression the Nax2 region first needed fine-mapping.
entries.pleiotropy: Strong Na+ exclusion usually well tolerated; very high K+ retrieval can trade off without salinity.

ip.text: HKT salt-tolerance applications have commercial history; run a patent query before use.

tomato.note: Tomato has SlHKT1;2; wild-tomato alleles track leaf Na+/K+ -> favourable native allele is an edit candidate.

wheat.note: Wheat's own story: Nax2 from crossable wild wheat.

rice.note: Rice OsHKT1;5 (SKC1) allele governs the trait.

entries.name: Plasma-membrane Na+ export
entries.does: Pumps Na+ out of the cell at the root surface and loads it for controlled long-distance handling.
entries.ref: Olias et al., 2009, Plant Cell Environ.
entries.linkage: Editing the crop's own gene -> no drag.
entries.pleiotropy: Dosage-sensitive: full knockout impairs growth under salt, so tune expression, do not remove.

ip.text: No specific patent confirmed in seed pass.

tomato.note: SlSOS1 is native and validated; tune its own expression/allele.

entries.name: Vacuolar sodium storage
entries.does: Moves Na+ into the vacuole; overexpression raises tolerance in several species.
entries.ref: Apse et al., 1999; later crop work
entries.pleiotropy: Constitutive overexpression can perturb K+ balance and growth; conditional expression safer.

ip.text: Long patent history across companies; confirm freedom-to-operate.

tomato.note: Native LeNHX family; edit the crop's own gene.

entries.name: Proton pump powering Na+ handling
entries.does: Vacuolar proton-pyrophosphatase; overexpression energises Na+ sequestration, improves salt/drought tolerance.
entries.pleiotropy: Highly pleiotropic: also affects auxin transport, root growth and P nutrition.

ip.text: AVP1 stress applications patented/licensed historically; verify before investing.

tomato.note: Native H+-PPase genes; up-regulate own copy.

entries.name: Whole-trait source: wild-tomato salt loci
entries.does: Mapped loci raise salt tolerance and fruit Na+/K+ balance; clearest salt-tolerance reservoir for cultivated tomato.
entries.linkage: HIGH linkage drag - the classic problem; salt loci often co-segregate with small fruit and poor quality. Fine-map + native edit to keep benefit without baggage.

ip.text: Introgression lines may carry plant-breeders' rights; check registry.

tomato.note: Crossable with cultivated tomato - classic cisgenic/introgression route.

entries.name: Seedlessness (stenospermocarpy)
entries.does: Master gene for seed/ovule development in fleshy fruits; suppression or knockout triggers seedlessness.
entries.ref: Royo et al. 2016; Florida A&M muscadine editing (USDA NIFA)
entries.linkage: Editing the crop's own AGL11 -> no drag, unlike crossing seedlessness in from another background.
entries.pleiotropy: AGL11/STK governs ovule and seed-coat development; loss can reduce berry size, firmness and fruit set.

ip.text: Concept published and actively pursued incl. public gene-editing projects for seedless grape. The case Burcu hit on blackberry: sound idea, taken space. Confirm freedom-to-operate first.

blackberry.note: Rubus carries its own AGL11; loss-of-function edit of the crop's own gene is the native route.

grape.note: Native VviAGL11 edit; most crowded IP space.

tomato.note: Tomato TAGL11 governs seed development; native-edit route, weigh fruit-set effects.
